description: Get a client's contact details, tags, custom fields, recent notes, and conversations in one call. Each recent_dialogs item includes link_to_dialog. Show these links as Markdown. Accepts a name, phone number, email, or client_id. If a name is ambiguous, the result lists candidates so you can retry with a client_id or phone number.

client.description: Client name, phone (any format), email or client_id.

include_dialog_history.description: Whether to include a list of the last 5 conversations. Defaults to true.

include_notes.description: Whether to include operator notes. Defaults to true.

response_format.description: 'concise' (default) keeps the text output short. 'detailed' adds per-item fields to the text output (ids, statuses, timestamps, full message texts). structuredContent always contains every field regardless of this parameter.

name: lookup_client_profile
title: Client profile lookup
